_comment: Fallback manifest for the provider model catalog (services/model_catalog.py).
It is used ONLY when a live /models probe fails (network down, credential
unreachable inside the backend container, provider 5xx). It is deliberately
NOT a source of truth about what a runtime RUNS — runtimes.model_identifier
stays the only answer to that question. This file only answers
'which models does this provider offer', and it will go stale; every entry
served from here is flagged status=manifest_fallback in the API so the UI
Keyed by wire protocol (harness_compat.runtime_protocol), not by runtime slug:
anthropic/grok/kimi are single-endpoint protocols. The 'openai' protocol has
no entry on purpose — every openai runtime is a different endpoint (local vLLM,
LM Studio, Ollama Cloud, ...), so a shared static list would be a lie.

grok.note: cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/models — the Grok Build CLI proxy, NOT api.x.ai. The public xAI API advertises ~10 models; the CLI proxy exposes exactly one, and only that one is drivable by the grok harness.
